messages:
deploy-bot: Release rc-2026.03.15 failed SBOM provenance gate for service 'session-store'
```
artifact: session-store:2.11.3
check: sbom_provenance
result: BLOCK
reason: missing base_image_digest in SBOM; provenance not attested
action: rebuild with pinned base OR provide provenance attestation
canary: 10% rolled
```
jenna: Adding context — this is the canary for session-store. the builder used ubuntu base from internal.registry but pipeline uses `:latest` tag for now, so no pinned digest in manifest.
ton y: We should not unblock without either a pinned digest or an attestation. Any chance platform can rebuild quickly with base pinned?
maria: We can trigger a rebuild that pins the base image digest. estimate ~45m including tests. can do in the change window.
rahul: From legal side I don't see new license red flags for the app itself, but we need the SBOM to be complete for audits.
eva: Current canary at 10%. Suggest pausing further rollout until resolved. if we keep going we risk failing compliance checks downstream.
jenna: Proposal: request a temporary exception for canary-only while we rebuild/pin. @tony can you approve an exception scoped to non-prod canary for 1h?
tony: @jenna I can approve only if we get an attestation from infra that the base image in the registry is immutable/pinned for that digest, or if the new rebuild pushes an image with a digest and updated SBOM. Otherwise rollback.
deploy-bot: Action required: add approval comment to this thread using `/approve-sbom-exception reason=<short reason> duration=1h scope=canary` to register the exception in compliance log.
jenna: Opening PR to rebuild and pin base: https://git.redwood/repos/session-store/pulls/482 — includes Dockerfile change to pin to `ubuntu@<digest>` and SBOM regen step. ETA ~30m. I'll also add the attestation note to the PR.
maria: Starting rebuild now. will push image as `registry.internal/redwood/session-store:2.11.3-rc-rebuild` with base digest. will post digest when done.
ton y: If rebuild produces SBOM including base purl+sha256 I'll lift the block for canary only. otherwise we rollback.
legal-bot: Automated license-scan queued for rebuilt artifact. no high risk licenses flagged so far.
eva: Holding canary at 10%. monitoring alerts set: if error_rate > 1% will rollback to previous stable.
jenna: Thanks all — pausing automated rollout. will update thread when image pushed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: DONE — pushed rebuilt image and updated SBOM. details:
image: registry.internal/redwood/session-store@sha256:abcd1234ef567890cafe9b1d2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b
SBOM: https://artifacts.redwood/sboms/session-store-2.11.3.sbom.json
attestation: infra-sig:sha256:attest12345 added to PR

tony: Verified SBOM contains base purl and sha and attestation present. lifting gate for canary only. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Gate cleared for canary. progressing rollout per policy `gradual-rollout-v2` -> increasing to 25% now. exception logged: approved_by=tony duration=1h scope=canary note="rebuild pinned base"
jenna: Leaving thread open until we hit 100% or we need rollback. great turnaround — thanks everyone :rocket:
